name: lean-delivery-greenfield
description: Guided greenfield setup for focused software changes using a compact fail-closed workflow with requirements, implementation, testing, and code review.

questions.prompt: What kind of change are you planning?

options.label: Focused feature or improvement
options.reason: Recommended because the change can be delivered through explicit requirements, implementation, testing, and review without a separate architecture or QA phase.

options.label: Small but validated bug fix
options.reason: Blocked because this setup does not register a distinct bug-fix composition; selecting it would materialize the same lean-delivery composition as the default focused-feature choice.

options.label: Architecture-heavy change
options.reason: Blocked because this setup has no separate Architect state. Use the orchestrated-delivery setup instead.

options.label: High-risk or release-critical change
options.reason: Blocked because this setup omits the separate QA acceptance phase required for higher-assurance delivery.

questions.prompt: How should failed validation be handled?

options.label: Return failures to implementation
options.reason: Recommended because failed tests and code review findings route back to the Implementer for correction.

options.label: Block unresolved failures
options.reason: Blocked because fail-closed retry behavior is already fixed by the lean-delivery workflow; this answer does not select a distinct composition.

options.label: Continue with warnings
options.reason: Blocked because generated workflows are fail-closed and do not permit unresolved validation failures to be ignored.

questions.prompt: Which target agent platforms should be generated?

options.label: OpenCode and VS Code Copilot
options.reason: Recommended because both registered target adapters are generated from the same validated composition.

options.label: OpenCode only
options.reason: Compatible because the OpenCode adapter is registered.

options.label: VS Code Copilot only
options.reason: Compatible because the VS Code Copilot adapter is registered.
